capital.evidence_quote: Vientiane is the capital and largest city of the Lao People's Democratic Republic

currency.evidence_quote: The Lao Kip (LAK) is the official national currency; Thai Baht and USD are often accepted

timezone.evidence_quote: Laos observes Indochina Time UTC+7 year-round without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Residential electrical distribution in Laos delivers 230V alternating current at 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Nominal alternating frequency across the grid is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Outlets in Laos accept flat two-pin Type A/B as well as round two-pin Type C/E plugs

sources.title: Ministry of Public Security of Lao PDR

police.evidence_quote: Dial 1191 for national emergency police services across Laos

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 1195 for volunteer ambulance and emergency medical dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 1190 for municipal fire and rescue services in Laos

general.evidence_quote: 1191 connects callers to primary police dispatchers

sources.title: Tourism Development Department of Lao PDR

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Police division hotline provides English assistance in Luang Prabang and Vientiane

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.en: Tourist cities Luang Prabang and Vang Vieng are safe; heed unexploded ordnance (UXO) warnings in rural areas.
advisory_headline.de: Luang Prabang und Vang Vieng sind sicher; im ländlichen Raum auf Blindgänger-Warnungen (UXO) achten.
advisory_headline.ru: Луангпхабанг и Вангвьенг безопасны; в сельской местности не сходите с троп из-за неразорвавшихся снарядов (UXO).
advisory_headline.es: Luang Prabang y Vang Vieng son seguros; atención a municiones sin detonar (UXO) en zonas rurales.

regional_warnings.area: Golden Triangle Special Economic Zone (Bokeo Province)
regional_warnings.reason: Presence of organized scam centers and casino zones; avoid travel to this enclave.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Laos measure approximately 29.2 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Laos reach 38.6 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Unitel and Lao Telecom offer tourist eSIMs with reliable 4G/LTE coverage. The Laos-China Railway (LCR) connects Vientiane, Vang Vieng, and Luang Prabang in 2 hours; book train tickets via the LCR Ticket app.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Unitel provides nationwide cellular coverage across main urban corridors and railway tracks

tr.conditions: Türk vatandaşları havalimanlarında ve uluslararası sınır kapılarında Kapıda Vize (VoA - 30 gün, 40$) veya online e-Visa alabilir.

us.conditions: US citizens can obtain a 30-day Visa on Arrival ($40 USD) or apply for an eVisa online before traveling.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens are eligible for a 30-day Visa on Arrival or online eVisa.

gb.conditions: British passport holders can purchase a Visa on Arrival (30 days, $40) or apply for an eVisa.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут въезжать в Лаос без визы на срок до 30 дней с туристическими целями.

dos.title: Respect the morning Alms Giving ceremony (Tak Bat)
dos.description: In Luang Prabang, observe monks collecting morning alms from a respectful distance; dress modestly and do not flash cameras in their faces.

dos.title: Book train tickets in advance on LCR Ticket app
dos.description: High-speed train seats between Vientiane, Vang Vieng, and Luang Prabang sell out days in advance; book via the official app.

dos.title: Remove shoes when entering temples and homes
dos.description: Always take off footwear before stepping onto monastery verandas or entering private Lao guesthouses.

donts.title: Don't touch or climb on ancient Buddha statues
donts.description: Buddha images are sacred religious objects; posing inappropriately or sitting on statues is offensive and illegal.

donts.title: Don't wander off marked paths in rural Xieng Khouang
donts.description: Laos is the most heavily bombed country per capita in history; strictly obey red unexploded ordnance (UXO) marker signs.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping is not traditional in Laos, but leaving 10% in upscale restaurants or tipping tour boat operators and guides is appreciated.
